acceptedRegression.reason: The exact zeros registration leaves outside the frame were corrupting the robust statistics: DSC04908 had a flattened-field sigma of 1.67e-6 against a true 4.28e-6, so its candidate existed only because of that 2.6x too-low threshold. Computing the statistics over the sky alone lost it. An accident stopped happening; detection ability did not change - the visual recall gate is still 9/9. The frame was already excluded from compositing by the plausibility guard (fit scale 0.097), so nothing reaches the output that did before.
